answer_1.quote: We fine-tune language models based on large silver-linked corpora that we identify using the PRM.
answer_1.outputs: Predictions of whether a policy item will be covered in news media and rankings of newsworthy leads.

answer_2.quote: We show in Table 5 results from fine-tuning GPT3 on full and ablated versions of the prompt.

answer_4.quote: Finally, we recruit two expert journalists and conduct human experiments with two aims: (1) is our "newsworthiness" definition repeatable and (2) are our models helpful?
answer_4.guideline: Journalists were asked to (a) indicate which policies they might write about and (b) guess whether the list was a newsworthiness list or a random sample.
